title: physaria floribunda subsp. osterhoutii
intro: Physaria floribunda subsp. osterhoutii, commonly known as Osterhout's bladderpod, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. It has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Osterhout's bladderpod include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory agent and an antioxidant, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
